response.original_title: La Vía del Dolor "El Amor Hecho Cruz"
response.overview: The Way of the Cross: ‘Love Made Cross’ is a raw and intimate cinematic immersion into the final 72 hours of Christ’s life. Far from static iconography, this film places us at the centre of an emotional storm, where faith collides with power and betrayal. From the serene yet anguished prayer in the Garden of Gethsemane, we capture the weight of a decision: the inescapable sacrifice.  The story unfolds in an intense and visually striking narrative, depicting the unjust trial, the brutality of the punishment and the final journey to Golgotha. The viewer witnesses, step by step, the Way of the Cross: not only the physical suffering of the scourging and the carrying of the cross, but also the profound pain of loneliness and abandonment by his loved ones. We highlight the Passion as the supreme act of love and obedience, a silent cry that echoes through the centuries.
response.title: The Way of the Cross: ‘Love Made Cross’
